title: PhoneStep::Sending holds no RequestId; the answer is matched by requests.has_auth_submit() (any auth submit) and last_auth_error.is_some()
trigger: Submit a phone number, then see the answer arrive
effect: sync_phone_step decides accepted vs rejected from the purpose class and a shared error slot, not from the request that Sending sent
fix: Sending { phone, back, request: RequestId } resolved by that id's answer

title: A second Enter while a sign-in submit is in flight shows 'Couldn't submit ...' although the first went out
trigger: Type a code, password, phone or recovery code and press Enter twice quickly (also Forgot password? twice, Resend recovery code)
effect: The Enter path ignores the busy state the buttons use; the driver refuses the second send (login_request has_purpose, or an emptied code/password field) and the handler sets StatusNote::error over the success note
fix: Skip the submit while has_auth_submit() (one guard in the submit_on_enter path)

title: Active::pressed_at is an Option<Instant> used as the 'middle button is down' flag for hold-or-toggle
trigger: Middle-press to anchor, release the button outside the window or after the window loses the mouse-up
effect: Option::take in autoscroll_release is the only exit from 'held'; a lost mouse-up leaves the mode in held state, so it keeps scrolling until a click or focus loss instead of toggling
fix: Active.button: Held{since} | Toggled

title: The Linux battery probe loop is detached and keeps probing while the window is hidden or locked
trigger: Linux with no portal or daemon signal and Save Power on Low Battery on: hide or lock the app
effect: The loop spawns a probe (gdbus) every 30 s forever (POLL), with no owner or hidden/locked gate; only the switch-off and event-driven cases park it
fix: Hold the Task in an owner that drops it on hide/lock, or park while no window is visible

title: BoostPhase::Working carries no RequestId; boost answers are matched by purpose and chat id
trigger: Press Boost (BoostChat or slots read in flight), close the box, reopen it for the same chat and press Boost again; then the first request's error lands
effect: The error arm (state/domains/groups/error.rs) and the ChatBoostSlots arm find the new box by chat id and reset its Working phase to Main with the old error note, so the button re-enables while the second request is still out and a second boostChat can be sent
fix: BoostWork::{Slots(RequestId), Boosting{request: RequestId, reassign}} and compare pending.id in the apply and error arms

title: EditStage { Loading, Editing } mirrors the session's BotText load stage beside it
trigger: Open the bot edit box; the box's own Loading/Editing and edit.name/about BotText::{Loading,Ready,Failed} must agree
effect: No bug today: loaded is computed from both, and fill_bot_edit (frame upkeep of the hosting window only) moves the box stage when the session stage turns Ready; a box hosted by a window that never draws stays Loading
fix: One stage: the fields are filled from BotText::Ready where it is first read, or the box stage carries the RequestIds it waits for

title: emoji_access_shown is only ever added to, and is added before the request is sent
trigger: Flip the Emoji Status switch on a bot profile; the send fails, or access is later revoked elsewhere
effect: The OfAccount set grows for the run and keeps the section visible for a bot that no longer has access (even when the first send failed); nothing clears it on closing the profile
fix: Per-profile stage (ProfileUi) that dies with the profile panel

title: StreamReveal::Finishing matches by message id only and is never reset when the chat changes
trigger: A bot reply finishes (Finishing{message}) and the user leaves the chat before the reveal ends; later a message with the same id is drawn in another chat of the account
effect: history.stream_reveal lives in the per-account HistoryUi, not per chat; drawing() ignores the chat, so a colliding id paints the old text's cut (or a stale frozen height) until a draft or the final frame ends it
fix: Key Finishing by ChatMessage and reset to Idle in sync_chat_ui

title: Appearing keeps its width and height animations in step by hand
trigger: Each frame; text_changed from a new draft or the final message
effect: No bug found: width/target_width/start_width/width_duration, height/target_height/shown_height, sweeps (First/Later, a two-variant enum), finalizing and the one-shot fresh bool are updated together in check_line, start_width and text_changed
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Width{tween,target,start}, Height{..} } per line, finalizing as part of the reveal stage

title: Verify/remove verification is fire and forget: the answer is not matched, a failure is never shown
trigger: Pick a chat and press Verify (or Remove); TDLib refuses (bot not allowed, flood, chat gone)
effect: submit_bot_verify drops the RequestId, sets a silent 'Verifying...' note and returns the box to Pick; no stage waits for the answer, so the pick shows the old state with no error and no end to the note
fix: Step::Sending { request: RequestId, chat } closed by the answer (acks.expect like BoxSend) with the error on the box

title: SimilarBotsFetch is a hand-made Fetch: Loading holds no RequestId, Failed is an absent entry
trigger: Press the similar-bots button on a bot card; the request is lost or answered late
effect: Answers (Loaded) and refusals (remove) are matched by purpose plus the bot's user id, not by the request held in Loading, and absence means both Idle and Failed so a failure cannot show its reason in the panel
fix: HashMap<i64, Fetch<Vec<i64>>> with Loading(RequestId) and Failed(error)

title: Going Back or picking another chat while an Add-bot send is out drops the start payload
trigger: Add a bot as administrator from a link with a start parameter, press Add as admin, then press Back (not disabled while sending) before the promotion answers
effect: belongs_to turns false, pump_box_send runs forget_box_send and drops then_start: the promotion still happens but sendBotStartMessage with the link's parameter is never sent
fix: Disable Back while box_sending(), or keep the follow-up in the session with the request instead of the box

title: baseline: BarFacts::bot_start_pending
trigger: A bot chat with a start parameter or an empty loaded history
effect: No bug: derived from bot_start_params and the history each frame, but it is a stage-named bool and the Start button stays shown until the reducer drops the parameter or a message arrives
fix: BottomBar decided from an enum StartState { NotStartable, Offered, Starting(RequestId) }

title: Unblock and restart sends /start right behind the unblock request, before it is answered
trigger: A blocked bot shows Restart; press it: set_chat_user_blocked returns Ok(Some) and restart_now is true
effect: start_bot_from_bar runs at once while the chat is still blocked on the server; if the unblock then fails the /start is refused and the bot stays blocked with two notes; only a refused or deduped send was guarded
fix: Chain the start on the unblock's answer (stage Unblocking{then_start})

title: HISTORY_AREA keeps the last history area per thread and is never cleared
trigger: Open Settings > Appearance (preview bubbles with a gradient theme) in the window whose chat was last painted, or close the chat
effect: gradient_layer falls back to history_area_of(window) which still holds the old chat geometry, so the preview or any non-history bubble takes a wrong slice of the gradient
fix: Report the area with an explicit owner each frame and clear it when the history stops painting; pass the area to bubbles instead of a thread-local

title: AddPeopleBox.search Option is a created flag and initial_query is a one-shot slot, both set during render
trigger: Open Add People: call_add_people_overlay (render) creates the field, takes initial_query, subscribes and fires search_add_people
effect: Box has two stages (not built, built) as Option + a String taken once; the request is sent from render
fix: enum AddPeopleStage { Opening{initial}, Open{search} } built when the box opens (window passed in)

title: The Add People search state in the Session is cleared by hand at four sites and not by the account's Farewell
trigger: Open Add People, type a name, switch account (CallScreen Farewell closes only the chooser and privacy box) and back
effect: call_boxes.add_people is dropped with OnScreen but Session.calls.add_people_search keeps the query and results until another close path or the call ending clears it
fix: Make the box's close (or Farewell) the single place that clears the search; or own the search inside AddPeopleBox

title: A request is queued from render while the sessions list is Idle and cannot be sent
trigger: Settings > Calls with live set but the chats path inactive (maybe_fetch_active_sessions returns Err, stays Idle)
effect: Every render of the section spawns another screen task that does nothing (no notify, so no loop, but wasted work per frame)
fix: Start the fetch when the section opens (an Asker/opener), not from render

title: call_window_target returns (call, ringing, ended, busy): two stage bools beside the ids
trigger: sync_call_window reads ended and busy from the tuple and recombines them with CallEnd and lingering
effect: No bug today; Active/Ringing/Ended/Busy are four stages of one thing kept as a tuple
fix: enum CallWindowTarget { None, Active{id}, Ringing{id}, Ended{id}, Busy{id}, Invite{key} }

title: baseline: CallSnap::connecting (beside CallPhase and status)
trigger: Status line is derived by call_status which returns (String,bool)
effect: connecting spins the ring; kept next to phase/status computed together
fix: Fold into CallPhase::Active{connecting} or a CallStatus enum returned by call_status

title: CallEnd::Lingering names a linger timer whose Task is detached, and lingering is read from Instant
trigger: Call ends; sync spawns cx.spawn(timer).detach() and flips Lingering back to Ended when it fires; a second sync decides by at.elapsed()
effect: Works (guarded by call_id); the stage says a timer runs but the timer is not held in it, and tests cannot drive it with a manual clock
fix: Hold the Task in CallEnd::Lingering{task} (dropped on a new call) and take time from a clock the tests control

title: window_closed_by_user and window_open_failed are Option<i32> call-id slots that only the call bar clears
trigger: Close the call window mid-call, end the call, later call again
effect: Nothing clears them at call end; they hold a dead call id (harmless while ids differ) and are one-shot slots with no way out except show_call_window
fix: enum WindowWanted { Open, ClosedByUser(call_id), OpenFailed(call_id) } reset by the call's end

title: CallPanel::devices_menu is reset by hand inside render when the phase leaves Active
trigger: Open the device menu, call ends; render sets devices_menu = None
effect: State written from render instead of by the call's transition; another window of the same call keeps its own copy
fix: Key the menu by call id (Option<(call_id, target)>) and ignore it when the call differs

title: thread-local CACHE.borrow_mut() is held across super::image_budget::retire_all (another module) in the if-let body
trigger: A fourth-and-later palette evicts an entry while retire_all calls wake()
effect: no re-entry into CACHE today, but panic-safety rule 6 forbids a borrow guard across a call into another module
fix: Take the evicted value out of the borrow first (let old = cache.borrow_mut().insert(..);) then retire it

title: sync_call_sounds resets CallBoxes::card_window by hand; four other sites also clear it (answer_call, dismiss_call_summary, dismiss_call_error) and dial_user sets it before the permission answer
trigger: An incoming call arrives while a chat window had pressed Call earlier
effect: the sound sync is where the card's window is cleared for an incoming call, so the card follows the call only because the tick or poll runs; a Call denied at the prompt leaves card_window set until the next dial or dismiss
fix: One call-owned value: ActiveCall/CallSummary carry `card_window` (or CallRoute::{MainWindow, Window(ChatId)}) set by the call's own transitions, not by sound sync

title: With Play sounds off, a mute/connect cue cuts a looping ring and plays nothing: spawn() stops the player before it checks `enabled`; the ring waits out a gap before it resumes
trigger: Play sounds off, a second call ringing during a call, press Mute (play_cue)
effect: the ring is cut for the gap (1 s) although play_cue promises it keeps ringing; player and Loop::On.phase are two fields kept in step by hand (phase set to Playing before spawn)
fix: Return before stop_player when the cue is muted and a loop is on; or make the ring and the cue two slots of one value

title: CallEnd::Lingering names a running linger timer while the Task is .detach()ed in sync_call_window, and the timer matches by call_id only
trigger: A 1:1 call ends and its window lingers; account switch and back with the same per-account call id while the old timer is pending
effect: an old timer can turn the new account's Lingering back to Ended, so the next sync starts a second timer; harmless today because the close is decided by `at.elapsed()`
fix: Hold the timer Task in CallEnd::Lingering { call_id, at, _timer }, so replacing the stage cancels it; no match by id needed (call_panel.rs:295)

title: CallUi::raised_for is app-wide but holds a per-account call id; CallScreen exists because ids repeat across accounts
trigger: Account A's call 1 rings and raises the open call window (raised_for = Some(1)); the window stays open (a second call or linger) as account B on screen gets its own call 1 ringing
effect: B's ringing call is not raised: raised_for == ringing, so the window is not brought to the front for a call that came in on another account. open_call_window resets it only when a new window opens
fix: Move raised_for into CallScreen (OnScreen, replaced whole on a switch), or key it by (AccountKey, call id)
